backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md three-window replay using exp-20260519-029 observation-universe snapshots because canonical snapshots do not fully cover the governed candidate pool

runtime_fields: target OHLCV rows in all three exp-20260519-029 snapshots
existing signal strategy field generated before next-open paper entry
signal-day dollar volume computed from close * volume
signal-day range_pct known after signal-day close
risk_engine.SECTOR_MAP target tickers patched from TARGET_SECTOR_MAP in replay

gate3.note: No new core filter, core entry rule, or paper admission filter was added. The experiment changes only default-off paper notional for already selected Space paper candidates, so core survival is unchanged.

gate4.acceptance_rule: positive aggregate EV/PnL versus core; zero EV/PnL-regressed windows versus core; aggregate EV/PnL improvement versus accepted exp-20260531-022; supported sample across >=2 windows; drawdown drift <=0.5pp; survival >=5%; concentration guard passes

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: capital allocation: already selected default-off Space paper candidates may deserve modest notional support when signal-day dollar volume is high and signal-day range is orderly.

2_history_check.exp-20260528-026: Accepted high-close trend route improved aggregate EV but should not be threshold-retuned on frozen windows.
2_history_check.exp-20260529-020: Accepted intraday-thrust refinement improved the high-close baseline; this keeps those admission rules fixed.
2_history_check.exp-20260531-022: Accepted ARKX>UFO breakout complement is the current Space default-off route; this tests support only after selection.
2_history_check.exp-20260601-024: Rejected ARKX/UFO selected support due full regression versus the accepted Space route; this uses a different production-visible cost/liquidity field.
2_history_check.llm_soft_ranking: Skipped because replay-safe Space semantic rows and closed same-theme replacement outcomes remain sparse.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same three docs/backtesting.md Space observation windows; positive aggregate EV/PnL versus core; no EV/PnL-regressed windows versus core; improvement versus accepted exp-20260531-022; >=3 supported target paper trades across >=2 windows; drawdown drift <=0.5pp; survival >=5%; target concentration inside guardrails; and no production/backtest split before promotion.

hypothesis: Accepted default-off Space paper candidates may have better expected value when signal-day liquidity is high and intraday range is orderly, because execution/friction quality should matter in small Space names.
interpretation: The Space cost/liquidity selected-candidate support is a positive replay lead, but it is not promoted in this runner because production must expose the same default-off metadata before retention.
next_evidence_needed: Add a shared default-off Space observation helper/parity test for the support metadata, then collect forward replacement-value rows.

prediction.confidence_reason: Cost-liquidity support helped other paper adapters, but Space selected rows are thin and nearby price-action/ETF retunes are frozen without new evidence.

production_impact.promotion_requirement: A passing replay remains a lead until the shared default-off Space observation helper and focused parity tests expose the same support metadata; live Space slots remain zero.

why_not_other_changes: Skipped LLM soft-ranking because replay-safe Space semantic rows remain sparse; skipped Space ticker expansion because prior broad Space pools failed stability or concentration; skipped ARKX/UFO notional retuning because exp-20260601-024 rejected that nearby support family.
